title: 航空構造力学Ⅱ
subtitle: Mechanics of Aircraft Structures II
educationalGoal:
Students will learn
(1) Thin-walled cross section bar under torsional moment
(2) Aircraft structural design under static loads
(3) Aircraft structural design under fatigue loads"
advice:
On the basis of knowledge learned in subjects such as'Strength of Materials for Aircraft structure' and 'Mechanics of Aircraft Structures I', student will learn the advanced topics in mechanics of aircraft structures.
We will cover the following materials:
(1) Thin-walled cross section bar under torsional moment
(2) Basic concepts of structural design methods under static loads
    (Strength ratio, Margin of safety)
(3) Basic concepts of structural design methods under fatigue loads
    (Safe life design, Damage tolerance design)

Students should thoroughly review what they have learned in
'Strength of Materials for Aircraft structure' and
'Mechanics of Aircraft Structures I'
before taking this course.
books: Basis of Understanding Strength of Materials -Second Edition, Kyoritsu Syuppan, 2013
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of Mechanics of Materials and Mechanics of Aircraft Structure.

activityGoals.body: Be able to calculate torsional stiffness and shear stress of bars with circular cross sections
Be able to explain the meanings of 'limit load' and 'ultimate load'
Be able to evaluate the static strength of aircraft structure using strength ratio or margin of safety
Be able to analyze fatigue strength in aircraft structures through fatigue life calculation
Be able to analyze fatigue strength in aircraft structures through damage progression calculation

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Accurately calculate the torsional stiffness
    and the torsional stress of bars with
    thin-walled section
(2) Accurately explain the meanings of 'limit load'
    and 'ultimate load'
(3) Utilize the strength factor or margin of safety
    to improve structural design
(4) Analyze fatigue strength in aircraft structures
    through fatigue life calculation
(5) Conduct damage progression calculation based on
    fracture mechanics and explain the concept of
    damage tolerance design
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Calculate the torsional stiffness of bars with
    circular cross section
(2) Explain the meanings of 'ultimate load'
(3) Evaluate the strength of aircraft structures
    under static loads using the strength factor
    or margin of safety
(4) Conduct  fatigue life calculation by using
    S-N curve
(5) Conduct damage progression calculation based on
    fracture mechanics
